findings.message: The unknown-player guard of the exported freeCoverage (packages/simulation/src/intel/step.ts:206, `!world.players.has(playerId)` returns null) has no test. Tests call freeCoverage only through buy() in packages/simulation/src/intel/intel.test.ts:718, always for a player in the view after control start. targetedRumorAvailability (step.ts:225) and stepIntel (step.ts:620) each reject an unknown player before freeCoverage runs, so no other path reaches the guard. Dropping the clause is a typecheck-clean one-line mutation (`if (!state.started || !config.types.includes(type)) return null;`). With it, freeCoverage returns 'covered' for a player missing from the view when their type is carrier-only after minute 28, and no test fails. This branch is new this round but outside item 7's enumerated list, which is fully proven (M1-M27 all trace to failing tests), so it does not block. A one-line assertion `freeCoverage(..., 'Z', 'moon') === null` after the reveal would close it.
findings.requirement: For each branch changed across the intel follow-ups, there is at least one deterministic test that fails when the branch is removed.
